blurb: Guests rent a private 18-foot picnic boat with plush seating, shade, and a built-in sound system. The boat is never shared and can be rented any day of the week. Guests bring their own food and drinks and can stream their playlist over the onboard Bluetooth speaker.
extraNote: Free rescheduling up to 48 hours before · Dedicated docks in Baltimore’s Inner Harbor at 40 International Dr, and in DC’s Navy Yard at 1492 Fourth St SE

quotes.text: The boat ride was dreamy and idyllic. And our driver, Alexis, enhanced the experience with her positive energy and historic facts… I definitely want to do this again.
